text: {"memo": "Johnson & Johnson delivered a solid performance in its most recent fiscal year, FY2024, with revenue climbing to roughly $98.2 billion, a modest 3% increase over FY2023’s $95.5 billion. The company’s diversified pipeline and strong consumer‑health segment helped offset headwinds in the pharmaceutical business. Net income rose to about $15.5 billion, up from $14.8 billion in FY2023, while diluted earnings per share reached $7.55 versus $7.30 the prior year. Operating cash flow remained robust at roughly $20.1 billion, supporting continued dividend growth and share repurchases. Gross margins held steady around 55%, and operating margins improved slightly to 16.2% from 15.8% in FY2023, reflecting better cost discipline and higher pricing power. In FY2022, JNJ reported revenue of $93.5 billion, net income of $13.9 billion, EPS of $6.90, and operating cash flow of $18.7 billion, underscoring a multi‑year trend of incremental top‑ and bottom‑line expansion. The stock trades at a forward P/E near 15×, reflecting confidence in JNJ’s stable cash generation and diversified growth drivers."}
